label: sec:categorical-dirac-operator-intro
html: We combine the substrate parameter q, the connection abla, and the Reeb derivation \xi into a single first-order operator whose two limits recover the gauge and matter terms of the categorical action. The categorical Dirac operator interpolates between the full covariant derivative at q = 1 and its purely contact component \iota_\xi abla as q o \infty. This formula defines a unique morphism in \mathbf{C} once abla, q, and \xi are fixed.
